versions.changelog:
Initial release of nginx-reverse-proxy skill.

- Provides automated nginx reverse proxy configuration for domain binding.
- Supports both HTTPS (port 443 with SSL) and HTTP (port 80) proxy setups.
- Generates nginx config files dynamically based on user-supplied domain and target IP:port.
- Offers step-by-step commands for configuration, SSL certificate acquisition, and nginx reload.
- Reports outcome including bound domain and target details.
